title: Δημοτικός παιδικός σταθμός με χριστουγεννιάτικη γιορτή

unsupported.quote: Θα ήθελα επίσης να τηρείται σε κάθε τμήμα η αναλογία ενός ενήλικα για κάθε οκτώ παιδιά, όσο είναι μέσα όλα τα παιδιά, δηλαδή από τις 9:00 έως τις 14:00
unsupported.reason: A staff-to-children ratio over a time window: the catalog fixes a head count per task and has no rule that counts the people present at each hour across overlapping tasks or ties it to a number of children.

notes: Each section has an early (07:00-15:00) and a late (08:00-16:00) shift with an educator row (needs a βρεφονηπιοκόμος) and a helper row; the two shifts overlap, so 'nobody in two positions at once' binds. The Wednesday celebration (17:30-20:00, 3 people) is the only evening task: it pushes a five-day week to 42.5 hours (the 40-hour cap binds) and makes the soft 12-hour rest bind (same-day day shift, or the 07:00 start on Thursday). With the file's positions each section has four adults from 09:00 to 14:00, so the ratio happens to hold, but it is not encoded. The reference score 4 is optimal: Wednesday's 8 day positions need 8 of the 9 staff, so at least 2 of the 3 celebration staff also work that day (two rest gaps under 12 hours, 2 x 2); every other soft rule is 0. Disruption: Nikos is ill on Tuesday 15/12 (he works the infants' early helper position); a feasible re-plan exists (hard 0). Sources (facts only, changed where useful): staff schedules rotate to cover the whole opening window of municipal nurseries, 07:00-16:00 - https://www.aftodioikisi.gr/ergasiaka-asfalistika/ergasiaka-ypallilwn-ota/epiptoseis-apo-ti-meiosi-tou-orariou-ton-paidagogon-stous-paidikous-stathmous-ti-apanta-o-panellinios-sindesmos-vrefonipiagogon/ ; the model operating regulation published in 2017 (KYA 41087/2017) sets a children-to-educator ratio per section and age group; the request states the head's own ratio, not a legal figure - https://www.ypes.gr/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/NPapof-41087-20171129.pdf
